description: Look up any Canadian postal code for FSA-level intelligence: community, province, approximate timezone, centroid coordinates, urban/rural classification, and NANP area codes. Built on 1,652 forward sortation areas from the community-sourced GeoNames CA dataset (CC-BY 4.0). Free 50 lookups/day; Pro $9/mo unlimited; $0.01/call pay-per-call.
title: Canadian Postal Code Intelligence
